newsitem.title: UK: Sugar firm but off highs after funds seen buying.
newsitem.headline: Sugar firm but off highs after funds seen buying.

text.p: LIFFE sugar firmed in morning trade as fund buying emerged, but sellers soon appeared to drag it back from highs, traders said.
By 1008 GMT, front month October was 90 cents higher at $323.70, having seen a high of $324.50. October dominated volume with 1,018 of 1,212 lots traded so far.
"There was a bit of fund buying," one trader said. But the $324.50 high was overdone and trade sellers had pushed prices down from that level, he said.
"There's not too much confidence that New York is going to go higher," he said.
New York sugar futures closed at two week highs on Wednesday amid brisk chart-driven fund buying, dealers said.
